== Summary ==
Portrait of [[Tim Ellington]], 200 × 200 px, the size the source serves. The source profile, under the name Tim Ellington, names the Decipher work quoted under Source.

== Source ==
* [https://www.linkedin.com/in/tim-ellington-60b5a38/ Tim Ellington], LinkedIn profile, read 27 October 2026 (profile photo; Experience: "Director, Creative Studio (2001 – 2005); Game Designer (1997 – 2001)", Decipher, "8 yrs 1 mo"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027203708/https://swccg.com/snapshots/linkedin/tim-ellington-60b5a38-decipher.html Internet Archive] (top card and Decipher entry; LinkedIn blocks direct Wayback captures of the profile URL), 27 October 2026.

== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Description:''' head-and-shoulders portrait of Tim Ellington.
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Tim Ellington]].
* '''Portion used:''' the whole image at the low resolution LinkedIn publishes; no larger copy was taken.
* '''Replaceability:''' no free photograph of the subject is known.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use of the photograph.
* '''Copyright:''' the photographer or Tim Ellington. Used under fair use for identification only.
